title: FontIntelligenceScoringModel
description: Comprehensive 10-dimensional typographic pairing evaluation and decision rubric.

visual_contrast.name: Visual & Structural Contrast
visual_contrast.description: Measures weight delta, stroke modulation contrast, and structural distinction between primary and secondary typefaces.

weight_delta.explanation: A weight difference of 300+ units (e.g. 700 Bold vs 400 Regular) provides unambiguous optical hierarchy.

stroke_contrast_interplay.explanation: Pairing a high-contrast display face with a monoline body face produces visual rhythm without cognitive strain.

serif_sans_relationship.name: Serif / Sans Classification Harmony
serif_sans_relationship.description: Evaluates cross-classification synergy, historical compatibility, and superfamily alignment.

serif_heading_sans_body.rationale: Classical editorial master pairing: serif conveys authoritative prestige while sans ensures modern screen legibility.

sans_heading_serif_body.rationale: Modern publishing cadence: clean geometric/grotesque title anchored by warm literary reading text.

display_heading_sans_body.rationale: High-impact visual anchor with functional, neutral body support.

superfamily_same_design.rationale: Guaranteed structural unity sharing underlying skeleton, proportions, and x-height.

contrasting_sans_subtypes.rationale: Geometric headline paired with Humanist or Neo-Grotesque body provides subtle contemporary contrast.

same_sans_subtype_different_family.rationale: Uncanny valley: two different neo-grotesques or two geometric sans look like an accidental mismatch.

dual_display_or_dual_decorative.rationale: Cacophony: competing expressive typefaces fight for focal dominance.

personality.name: Personality & Mood Resonance
personality.description: Evaluates aesthetic coherence, brand tone harmony, and absence of accidental tonal friction.

complementary_resonance.rationale: Heading establishes bold stylistic stance while body provides understated, confident foundation.

shared_mood.rationale: Both fonts emanate the same thematic intent (e.g. both sleek minimal or both technical).

neutral_subordination.rationale: Expressive primary font balanced by an entirely neutral, unopinionated workhorse.

tonal_friction.rationale: Conflicting emotional signals (e.g. playful cartoon marker with corporate legal serif).

polar_clash.rationale: Severe mismatch that confuses the brand message and breaks immersion.

readability.name: Readability & Optical Legibility
readability.description: Evaluates legibility factors for body and UI roles: x-height, open apertures, distinct letterforms, and numerals.

width.name: Width & Proportional Harmony
width.description: Assesses horizontal rhythm, character width ratios, and optical tracking balance.

balanced_proportions.rationale: Both fonts share natural, comfortable letter proportions.

deliberate_display_contrast.rationale: Ultra-condensed or ultra-extended headline paired with standard-width body text for intentional editorial drama.

accidental_width_discord.rationale: Body font is noticeably condensed or unnaturally wide, hurting reading velocity.

weight_availability.name: Weight Availability & Semantic Breadth
weight_availability.description: Rewards fonts offering rich weight ladders, variable font axes, and true companion italics.

variable_or_8_plus_weights.rationale: Maximum flexibility for responsive breakpoints and intricate hierarchy ladders.

5_to_7_weights.rationale: Solid professional range covering Light, Regular, Medium, SemiBold, and Bold.

3_to_4_weights.rationale: Standard coverage for Regular, Italic, and Bold.

1_to_2_weights.rationale: Constrained hierarchy; requires artificial scaling or limited roles.

role_compatibility.name: Typographic Role Compatibility
role_compatibility.description: Verifies that each font satisfies the requirements of its assigned functional role (hero, heading, body, UI, code, button).

perfect_role_fit.rationale: Both fonts are natively engineered and curated for their assigned roles.

acceptable_secondary_role.rationale: Font is performing a secondary supported role without compromise.

misassigned_role.rationale: Font forced into an unsuitable role (e.g. decorative font as body or mono as display headline).

project_style.name: Project Style & Aesthetic Alignment
project_style.description: Evaluates how accurately the pair embodies the intended aesthetic style (luxury, editorial, technical, brutalist, minimal, modern, corporate).

both_match_project_style.rationale: Cohesive immersion: both fonts strongly represent the target project aesthetic.

headline_leads_style_body_neutral.rationale: Heading articulates the brand style while body guarantees universal accessibility.

style_mismatch.rationale: Fonts evoke conflicting or inappropriate styles for the stated project goal.

language.name: Language & Unicode Script Coverage
language.description: Validates full glyph coverage for target languages and scripts, preventing glyph fallback and tofu boxes.

full_script_and_language_parity.rationale: All target language diacritics and character sets are fully supported by all fonts in the system.

minor_extended_latin_delta.rationale: Minor differences in obscure unicode blocks, but core target locale fully covered.

critical_script_mismatch.rationale: One font lacks Cyrillic, Greek, or accented characters required by the application.

platform.name: Platform & Rendering Suitability
platform.description: Considers rendering engine targets, webfont formats (WOFF2/WOFF), payload efficiency, and screen rasterization.

web_optimized_variable_woff2.rationale: Modern WOFF2/variable font payload; lightning-fast page speed and smooth subpixel rendering.

standard_web_otf_ttf.rationale: High-quality desktop/web outlines; standard bundle size.

legacy_or_heavy_outlines.rationale: Heavy glyph outlines or missing modern compression formats.

grade_tiers.description: Flawless typographic synergy. Optimal visual contrast, immaculate hierarchy, and effortless legibility.
Outstanding production pair. Expresses distinct personality with rock-solid reading comfort.
Dependable, practical pair. Clear hierarchy with minor styling or weight considerations.
Viable pairing, but requires deliberate size scaling, letter spacing, or weight selection to avoid flatness.
Noticeable contrast deficiency or slight aesthetic tension. Recommend exploring alternative partners.
Fails critical readability, contrast, or role criteria. Severe typographical discord.
